regimeSub: Sep NFP miss (29K vs ~150K est) cools Dec hike bets; 10Y backs off 5.29% to 5.24% as growth fears emerge.
themes: Sep NFP prints 29K (vs ~150K est per CNBC Oct 2), UE ticks to 4.2% → 10Y retraces 5bps to 5.24% as Dec hike odds compress; Williams' 'no urgency' stance (Sep 29) gains credibility with labor market cracking

2s10s curve steepens to -46bps (2Y at 4.78% vs 4.88% prior) as front-end rallies harder than belly → markets pricing higher probability of Fed pause through Q1'27 despite Warsh's inflation hawkishness
Brent fades to $102.25 (-0.1% WoW) as Saudi/Iran post-ceasefire supply normalizes per Reuters (Jun 14 interim deal) → gold dips to $4162 (-1.0%) as real rates stabilize with 10Y off highs
SPX rallies 0.7% to 7722 as weak NFP = goldilocks for risk; KOSPI +0.3% to 7003 with BOK at 3.0% (Aug hike) keeping KRW stable at 1344 despite HBM capex concerns flagged in Korea Times (Sep 10)

headline: Sep NFP whiffs at 29K vs 150K est, triggering 10Y relief rally to 5.24% as Warsh's Dec hike path narrows amid stagflationary crosscurrents with CPI still at 3.7%.
